scientific_integrity: Homotopy equivalence proved by an explicit fixed-orbit PL model, graph-of-spaces cone links, and integral CW cell cancellation. Prior ambient homotopy multiplicities are credited, not claimed new.
scientific_limitations: Single coordinate transpositions of binary Hamming cubes at inclusive Rips scale two, n>=3. The proof uses the published integral nonequivariant scale-two Rips classification, and the additional finite tests are not an independent proof of all parameters. Literature priority cannot be exhaustively certified.
title: Coordinate-transposition fixed loci of scale-two hypercube Rips complexes
